chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Ja'far ibn 'Uthman, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning:
A man who does not perform ghusl on Friday in the early part of the day—he said: he should make it up in the latter part of the day; and if he is not able, then let him make it up on Saturday.
And we have exhaustively covered what relates to this chapter in our book Tahdhib al-Ahkam.

key_terms.آخِرِ النَّهَارِ: the latter part of the day
key_terms.أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ: the early part of the day
key_terms.الْأَغْسَالِ الْمَسْنُونَةِ: recommended ritual baths established in the sunnah (prophetic tradition)
key_terms.يَقْضِيهِ: he makes it up after missing its preferred time
key_terms.يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ: Saturday, the day on which it may still be made up
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day on which this recommended ghusl is prescribed

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he misses the Friday ghusl early in the day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the recommended Friday ghusl. If it is missed at the beginning of Friday, it may be made up later that day, and if that is not possible, it may be made up on Saturday.
